== 2014 Holotable image ==
[[File:VB6-L-jabbasprizefront-pre.gif|thumb|Block 6 face distributed by Holotable in December 2014]]
The December 2014 Holotable Set 0 archive shipped this complete Light Side front with the Block 6 diamond and slip number 65. It already reduces the number of cards allowed under the Starting Effect by one. The August 2016 Master Set image above shows the Modern slip.<ref>[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-reset image archive], December 2014, member <code>cards/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jabbasprizefront.gif</code>.</ref>

== Early Set 0 sheet ==
The 2014 sheet shows the Light Side front with the Starting Effect slot reduction. The later 2016 sheet supplies the exact image shown here.<ref>Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Set 0], official text as of 1 August 2016, page 9.</ref>
